records.part: 122 VMS at stations to be replaced (installed 1997-2015)
records.reason: The current VMS are no longer supported by the manufacturer.

records.part: PADS (train arrival prediction / passenger information) modernization
records.reason: The existing PADS was designed in 2012, deployed in 2014, and has reached the end of its useful life.

records.part: VHF voice radio system consolidation/modernization for tunnel coverage and emergency services
records.reason: The current voice and PTC systems utilize a leaky coaxial design to provide radio coverage in Caltrain\u2019s tunnels, which has been inadequate for train crews to communicate to dispatch

records.part: Digital customer displays with text-to-speech capabilities at multi-level stations
records.reason: Riders will be able to identify the correct platform at the impacted stations, which will improve customer experience and provide a safer environment

records.part: PA system overhaul: speakers, amplifiers, zone controllers, digitization
records.reason: The audio (speaker, amplifier, zone controller) at stations are obsolete.

records.part: Six additional BEMU trains for Gilroy service expansion
records.reason: This project includes the procurement of six additional BEMU trains to provide additional service to Gilroy before the electrification of this part of the corridor

records.part: Consolidated real-time operational database/data warehouse system
records.reason: This project provides a single repository of real-time operational data, seamless user interaction, and improved cybersecurity

records.part: Broadband wireless communications system for wayside train maintenance diagnostics and passenger Wi-Fi
records.reason: This program will design a broadband wireless communications system along the Caltrain corridor for the wayside train maintenance diagnostics and passenger Wi-Fi service.

records.part: Digital voice radio system migration replacing obsolete radio equipment
records.reason: This program is part of the continual effort to migrate toward a digital voice radio system to replace existing obsolete equipment for crews working in the operating right-of-way or onboard trains.

records.part: Broadband wireless communications system enhancements for onboard operational data (EMU, CCTV, passenger counting)
records.reason: This program expands upon Caltrain\u2019s broadband wireless communication system currently under construction to permit the transfer of onboard operational systems data

records.part: Digital customer displays with text-to-speech capabilities at South Santa Clara County stations
records.reason: This will provide up-to-date train service information to customers using these stations, which currently do not have VMS.

records.part: Overhead Contact System (OCS) reliability/safety improvements and monitoring system
records.reason: The Catenary System is a critical component of the Caltrain electrification system, providing electrical power to trains.

records.part: New private wireless network as backup to fiber optic architecture
records.reason: This project creates a private wireless network as the backup to Caltrain\u2019s fiber optic architecture and provides a significant improvement to overall system resiliency

records.part: Cellular-based broadband wireless system for diesel trains
records.reason: This project will implement a cellular-based broadband wireless system on diesel trains, enabling better passenger Wi-Fi services while onboard.
